notes.title: Patch Demo V0.1.11-2
notes.notes:
Dear Dungeoncrawlers!  



Version 0.1.11-2 brings improvementsand bugfixes.  



Improvements:

Added particle physics

Improved menu navigation

Changed explosive barrel interaction. You can now pick it up.

Bugfixes: 

HP is now updated correctly when you equip gear.

Fixed issue with health bar rounding

Fixed an issue where the sound volume was displayed incorrectly in the menu.

Would you like to join our Discord, share your thoughts, give feedback and help improve the game?

Then join here: https://discord.gg/MVYvMAbTkY  Play the Demo and share your thoughts, Your feedback shall help make the game even better!

notes.title: Patch Demo V0.1.8-4
notes.notes:
Dear Dungeoncrawlers!

Version 0.1.8-4 brings some balancing, improvements, and bug fixes. The balance of the game continuously revised.

Balancing:

 Balanced slot machines
 Reduced speed of the large fire slime
 Reduced missile speed
 Reduced additional speed for rage
 Added Etherium crates so you can find more Etherium in the depths


Improvements:

 Reduced several slomo durations
 Reduced slippery of the sprint
 Added target FPS option


Bug fixes:

 Fixed screenshake settings


Known bugs:

 Key binding resets sometimes.
 When the inventory is open, the player can sometimes be moved and the menu can no longer be closed

notes.title: Patch Demo V0.1.8
notes.notes:
Dear Dungeoncrawlers!

Version 0.1.8 brings some balancing, improvements, and bug fixes. The balancing of the game is a problem that is to be gradually revised.

Balancing:

 More Start HP
 Higher meat(heals) drop chance


Improvements:

 Added DPad UI navigation
 Added toggle for PixelPerfect. Default: disabled (disabled - no jitter, less beautiful, enabled - a bit jitter, very beautiful)


Bug fixes:

 The screenshake settings now work for all types of screenshake
 The audio settings now work for all SFX
 Fixed window mode


Known bugs:

 Key binding resets sometimes.
 When the inventory is open, the player can sometimes be moved and the menu can no longer be closed
